summary: Independent Bank Corp. filed an 8-K to announce a quarterly common stock dividend of $0.64 per share, payable July 9, 2026, to holders of record June 29, 2026. This is a routine capital return event, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC action, or management change is described. The filing is solely a standard dividend declaration, which does not constitute a special-situation event for classification purposes.
